$comment: FitRam is never published to an app store - see docs/DISTRIBUTION.md.
Every profile here is distribution: internal, meaning builds install directly onto
registered devices and never pass through App Store Connect or Play Console.
There is deliberately no `submit` section and no app-bundle profile: Play requires an
AAB, so producing only APKs means there is nothing here that a store would accept.
Restoring either would be a conscious reversal of that decision, not an accident.

device.$comment: The one you actually install and use. Android: a sideloadable APK. iOS: an ad-hoc build for UDIDs registered via `eas device:create`, which needs a paid Apple Developer account.
